timeline.title: A bit of my story
timeline.subtitle: From user to expert in the SAP system

step1.title: The Real Life School
step1.content: Before configuring the system, I lived the process. As Operations Leader at Dessol, I managed inventory, people, and the chaos of daily logistics. It was here that I understood an ERP is not just software; it’s the heart of the company. This experience gave me the business vision that many purely technical consultants lack.

step2.title: The Great Transition
step2.content: I decided I wanted more. I migrated to consulting (Bronxs Agro Systems) diving headfirst into SAP HANA. I learned to transform business processes into system configurations. I mastered Master Data and the tax complexities of Brazil. It was the beginning of building my technical profile: resilient and solution-focused.

step3.title: High Performance Consulting
step3.content: Passing through AdopTI and Engine Brasil, I refined my toolbox. It was no longer just about 'making it work', but optimizing it. I led AMS fronts, critical support, and implementations. Here, mastering Debugging, Brazil Localization (TAXBRA), and the integration between purchasing and tax became my signature.

step4.title: The Big Leagues
step4.content: Working as a Senior on global projects and S/4 HANA and Fiori implementations from scratch (Greenfield). Today, I use advanced tools like Migration Cockpit and Flexible Workflow to deliver not just a system, but a complete digital transformation for major market players.

step5.title: The Future: Your Journey
step5.subtitle: I will show you the ropes
step5.content: It took me years to decipher the SAP ecosystem, making mistakes and getting it right to get where I am. You don’t need to take that long. I’ve compiled my field experience, from support to Senior implementation, to guide you. Shall we build your authority in the SAP market together?
